name: Listen to this page
description: Listen to articles and selected passages with free, installed Mac voices. A panel player has pause/resume, speed and voice selection, progress seeking, paragraph navigation, and a follow-along transcript. No cloud upload or API key. Open Panels → Listen to this page; playback starts only when you press Play. Select page text then Refresh to read only that passage. Extracts visible semantic paragraphs, up to 30,000 characters; it cannot read PDFs, images, cross-origin frames, or hidden/paywalled text. Voice quality depends on installed macOS voices. No audio-file export. Navigating away removes the panel and stops playback.
